review.tagline: Real-time webcam face swap from a single source image
review.summary: Deep-Live-Cam is a Python desktop GUI that swaps a face from one source image onto a webcam feed, video or image, using ONNX models (inswapper_128_fp16, gfpgan-1024). It supports mouth masking, mapping different faces to multiple subjects, and CPU, CUDA, CoreML, DirectML and OpenVINO execution providers. A paid pre-built edition with extra features is sold on the project website.
review.audience: Creators and streamers wanting local real-time face swapping on a webcam
strengths: Live webcam mode plus image and video file processing from one GUI
Execution providers for CPU, CUDA, CoreML, DirectML and OpenVINO
Mouth mask and face mapping for multiple subjects in one frame
Needs only a single source image, no per-face training
weaknesses: Manual install needs Python, ffmpeg, CUDA/cuDNN pinning; README says not for beginners
CPU-only mode is slower; live preview takes 10-30 seconds to appear
Command-line arguments are marked unmaintained in the README
insightface models are limited to non-commercial research use
needs: Needs Python 3.11-3.14, ffmpeg, onnxruntime, CUDA Toolkit 12.8 (NVIDIA), tkinter, OBS (for streaming output)
